puzzles.title: Crescent Night & Dates Table
puzzles.subtitle: Compare both scenes carefully and tap the 4 quiet differences.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Scan the upper night sky first, then look across the table dishes — what shifted or vanished?
puzzles.praise: Sharp eyes on the first night of Ramadan ✨

puzzles.title: Preparing the Iftar Table
puzzles.subtitle: How do we ready the table gently? Slide both dates and water onto the table.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Ask your child which two blessings belong at the center of our iftar table.
puzzles.praise: Wonderful! A warm table ready for sunset 🌴

puzzles.title: Assemble the Emerald Lantern
puzzles.subtitle: Place the crown, glass, flame, and base cleanly to light the 3rd night.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Start with the center ivory frame, then top it with the golden crown.
puzzles.praise: Gorgeous! A Paper-Cut fanous glowing bright 🏮

puzzles.title: Watering the Date Palm Grove
puzzles.subtitle: Rotate the Paper-Cut canals to guide fresh water to the date grove!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Trace one step at a time from the top-left spout downward.
puzzles.praise: The grove is watered — fresh dates ahead 🌴

puzzles.title: The Lantern Alleyway
puzzles.subtitle: A peaceful street dressed for Ramadan — spot all 4 changes below!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Check the colors of the lanterns, the basil pot, and the paper arch carefully.
puzzles.praise: Wonderful observation — every lantern catches the eye 🏮

puzzles.title: How Many Date Bowls Are Here?
puzzles.subtitle: Some bowls hide underneath the table and boxes! Slide covers aside before counting.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Encourage moving every prop first before locking in the count!
puzzles.praise: Clever! You checked underneath before answering 👍

puzzles.title: Irrigating Two Neighbor Gardens
puzzles.subtitle: Turn the tee-junction wisely so water nourishes both gardens at once!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Start at the T-tile in row 2: aim it right and downward simultaneously.
puzzles.praise: Water flows generously to both gardens 💧

puzzles.title: Archway & Golden Finial
puzzles.subtitle: Fit both pillars, the arch roof, and the golden crest atop the doorway.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Build the left and right pillars first so the arch has sturdy support.
puzzles.praise: Well balanced — pure architectural harmony 🕌

puzzles.title: Quiet Mosque Courtyard
puzzles.subtitle: Look closely at the Mushaf stand and courtyard details — find 4 changes.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Compare the sky stars first, then check the stand size and water vessel.
puzzles.praise: Well done! Calm focus reveals every detail 🕌

puzzles.title: Setting the Quran Corner
puzzles.subtitle: The prayer mat awaits! Slide the Mushaf stand cleanly into place.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Ask which item completes the quiet corner beside the prayer mat.
puzzles.praise: Lovely! A calm nook ready for daily recitation 📖

puzzles.title: Courtyard Fountain Stream
puzzles.subtitle: Steer the canal neatly around courtyard stones to reach the thirsty rose.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Notice the water enters from the north — turn east along row 1 first!
puzzles.praise: Smart routing — the courtyard rose blooms 🌹

puzzles.title: Open Mushaf & Stand
puzzles.subtitle: Assemble the crossed wooden stand and the two open ivory pages.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Place the crossed base legs first so the open pages rest squarely above.
puzzles.praise: Clean spatial fit — time for a short surah 📖

puzzles.title: The Blessed Suhoor Kitchen
puzzles.subtitle: Quiet preparation before dawn — spot the 4 differences on the counter.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Ask which vessel swapped places and which warm pot vanished.
puzzles.praise: Great teamwork before dawn ✨

puzzles.title: Fourteenth Night Lantern Hunt
puzzles.subtitle: Extra lanterns glow beneath the bushes and doorway! Uncover and count all of them.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Remind your child that lanterns can glow beneath arches and foliage.
puzzles.praise: Brilliant! All 7 lanterns accounted for 🏮

puzzles.title: Mid-Ramadan Canal Crossroads
puzzles.subtitle: Guide the stream into the fixed crossroad to nourish both trees below.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Reach the center cross-tile first, then route each branch cleanly downward.
puzzles.praise: Clean logic — both olive sprout & tree thrive 🌿

puzzles.title: The Kindness Charity Box
puzzles.subtitle: Join the chest, lid, golden ribbon, and warm crest together.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Anchor the main emerald chest first, then place its lid and ribbon.
puzzles.praise: Well done! Giving brings joy to every home 💛

puzzles.title: Reading & Charity Nook
puzzles.subtitle: A peaceful corner with a Mushaf and charity box — find 4 changes.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Compare the charity box size, the hanging lantern, and the sunny window.
puzzles.praise: Keen eyes! Quiet corners teach patience 📖

puzzles.title: Watering the Courtyard Basil
puzzles.subtitle: The little basil plant is thirsty at dusk! How can we help it bloom?
puzzles.parent_whisper: Bring the nearby water vessel to the thirsty basil gently.
puzzles.praise: Lovely! Gentle care makes every garden thrive 🌱

puzzles.title: The Balanced Twin Stream
puzzles.subtitle: Split the stream evenly left and right to refresh both garden beds.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Notice the symmetry: bring water straight down into the T, then turn both arms!
puzzles.praise: Perfect symmetry — both blooms are refreshed 💧

puzzles.title: Mosaic Star Tile
puzzles.subtitle: Snap all four pointed tips around the ivory center to finish the tile.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Watch which triangle tip points upward, downward, east, and west.
puzzles.praise: Crisp geometry as the Last Ten begin ✨

puzzles.title: Garden of the Last Ten
puzzles.subtitle: Calm dusk under the olive tree — discover the 4 differences.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Notice the moon's size and the vessel waiting next to the garden bench.
puzzles.praise: Beautiful attention to detail 🌿

puzzles.title: Neighbor's Gift in the Last Ten
puzzles.subtitle: Share kindness during the final ten nights! Move the dates toward the gift corner.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Talk about the joy of sharing fresh dates with neighbors and grandparents.
puzzles.praise: Beautiful heart of generosity 🎁

puzzles.title: Winding Orchard Brook
puzzles.subtitle: A thoughtful zigzag between orchard rocks — steer the brook home!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Try working backward one tile up from the flower basin!
puzzles.praise: Reverse reasoning wins — the flower shines 🌟

puzzles.title: Twin-Minaret Mosque Silhouette
puzzles.subtitle: Set the central dome between twin minarets and crown it with gold.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Notice the peaceful symmetry — matching towers flank the ivory hall.
puzzles.praise: Harmonious silhouette 🕌

puzzles.title: Hallway of Generosity
puzzles.subtitle: Welcome and kindness — spot 4 quiet differences between scenes.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Look closely at the door state, the rose in the corner, and the gift box.
puzzles.praise: Sharp eyes and generous hearts 🤍

puzzles.title: Quiet Stars of the Odd Nights
puzzles.subtitle: How many stars shimmer above the clouds and crescent? Nudge them aside first!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Count slowly once every cloud and the crescent have been slid out of the way.
puzzles.praise: Eight bright stars spotted in calm focus ✨

puzzles.title: Three Trees on an Odd Night
puzzles.subtitle: Two consecutive T-junctions can water all three trees at once!
puzzles.parent_whisper: Line up row 2 horizontally while letting each vertical stem feed a basin.
puzzles.praise: All three trees flourish together 🌳

puzzles.title: Orchard Ready for Eid
puzzles.subtitle: Direct the central stream cleanly toward both the garden rose and fruit orchard.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Route the T-junction so water enters from the north and branches both west and south!
puzzles.praise: Wonderful logical thinking — ready for Eid 🌸

puzzles.title: Eve of Eid Preparation
puzzles.subtitle: Joy knocks at the door — spot all 4 changes before Eid morning.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Inspect the Eid sweets size, gift angle, and the bowl of dates.
puzzles.praise: Wonderful teamwork — Eid Mubarak in advance 🌙

puzzles.title: Ramadan Farewell Gifts
puzzles.subtitle: Small Eid gifts await around the room! Peek beside the chest and sofa to count all of them.
puzzles.parent_whisper: Slide the toy chest and sofa slightly before locking in the count.
puzzles.praise: Taqabbal Allahu minna wa minkum — sharp minds through the month 🎁
